_comment: Reference only — not applied to any AWS account. Fill in placeholders (<...>) before registering. Sizing: 0.5 vCPU / 1GB, x86 in dev / ARM in prod. Runs in a private subnet with no internet egress — all AWS service access goes through VPC endpoints, and config/secrets come from SSM Parameter Store.

runtimePlatform._comment_arch: Use ARM64 in prod (Graviton); X86_64 in dev

_comment_execution_role: Needs AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy (ECR pull, CloudWatch Logs write) + logs:CreateLogGroup (AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy does not include it; also covered by awslogs-create-group below if the role allows it) + ssm:GetParameters/GetParameter (+ kms:Decrypt if SecureString uses a CMK)
_comment_task_role: App-level permissions: S3 (s3_pdfs_bucket, s3_ingest_results_bucket, s3_chat_files, s3_logos_bucket), DynamoDB (dynamodb_table_messages), Bedrock (bedrock:InvokeModel, bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream), SQS SendMessage (once/if the ingestion-trigger integration exists)
_comment_stop_timeout: Generous drain window for long-lived SSE chat responses, still under the ALB's ~150s idle timeout

containerDefinitions.name: rag-fastapi
containerDefinitions._comment_health_check: The ALB listener rule that bypasses Cognito auth (unauthenticated pass-through) and the target group health check must both point at this same path: /api/v1/health/check
containerDefinitions._comment_no_aws_keys: Do NOT set AWS_PROFILE/AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY here, not even as empty strings — omitting them entirely lets the app fall back to the task role's IAM credentials (verified in app/core/aws_clients.py and app/core/container.py).
containerDefinitions._comment_weaviate: Weaviate runs self-hosted inside the VPC (private data subnet) and is reached by private IP/internal DNS, not a public SaaS endpoint — WEAVIATE_URL/WEAVIATE_GRPC above must resolve within the VPC.
containerDefinitions._comment_no_nat: This task has no internet egress (no NAT gateway). Any dependency reached over the public internet (e.g. a third-party API) needs its own VPC endpoint or must be swapped for a VPC-internal equivalent before this task definition is usable as-is.
